items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Wins FDA Review For BOTOX Cosmetic In Jawline Treatment Push
items.summary: Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, reported that the FDA has accepted for review a supplemental Biologics License Application for BOTOX Cosmetic to treat masseter muscle prominence. If cleared, BOTOX Cosmetic would be the first neurotoxin approved in the U.S. for this condition, supported by positive Phase 3 trial data. items.title: ABBV Q2 Deep Dive: Immunology and Neuroscience Expansion Shape Outlook Amid Guidance Reset
items.summary: Pharmaceutical company AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.2% year on year to $16.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.65 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
